en: May our devotion be so acceptable in Your sight, O Lord, that at the pleading of him on whose feast day it is offered, it may be an aid to us; through our Lord Jesus Christ, Your Son, who lives and reigns with You in the unity of the Holy Spirit, God, world without end.

la: Da, quǽsumus Dómine, fidélibus tuis, Sanctórum tuórum semper veneratióne lætári; et eórum perpétua supplicatióne muníri: Per Dóminum nostrum Iesum Christum, Fílium tuum: qui tecum vivit et regnat in unitáte Spíritus Sancti Deus, per ómnia sǽcula sæculórum.
en: Grant to Your faithful, we beseech You, O Lord, ever to be gladdened by the veneration of Your saints, and to be fortified by their interceding prayer: through out Lord. Through our Lord Jesus Christ, Your Son, who lives and reigns with You in the unity of the Holy Spirit, God, world without end.

la: Deus, qui fidélium salúti procurándæ, beátum Damiánum Confessórem tuum, et mira dicéndi vi, et virtútibus decorásti: præsta quǽsumus, ut ejus intercessióne et exémplo; veram caritátem verbo et ópere exhibeámus: Per Dóminum nostrum Iesum Christum, Fílium tuum: qui tecum vivit et regnat in unitáte Spíritus Sancti Deus, per ómnia sǽcula sæculórum.
en: O God, who for the salvation of the faithful adorned blessed Damian, Your confessor, with virtues and powers of speech' alike wondrous, grant, we pray Y u that through his intercession and example, we may show forth true charity both in word and deed; through our Lord Jesus Christ, Your Son, who lives and reigns with You in the unity of the Holy Spirit, God, world without end.

la: Súscipe Dómine hanc hóstiam, quam tibi immolámus: et méritis beáti Damiáni Confessóris tui præsta, ut sicut ipse se tibi in sacrifícium óbtulit, ita nos ad te omnes afféctus cordis dirigámus: Per Dóminum nostrum Iesum Christum, Fílium tuum: qui tecum vivit et regnat in unitáte Spíritus Sancti Deus, per ómnia sǽcula sæculórum.

Sacraméntum Córporis et Sánguinis tui, Dómine, quod súmpsimus, sit fragilitátis nostræ subsídium: ut beátum Damiánum Confessórem tuum imitántes; viam mandatórum tuórum currámus. Qui vivis et regnas cum Deo Patre, in unitáte Spíritus Sancti, Deus, per ómnia sǽcula sæculórum.
en: May the sacrament of Your body and blood, O Lord, which we have received be the strength of our weakness; that imitating Your blessed confessor, Damian, we may run the way of Your commandments: who live and reign. may celebrate their everlasting glory, and by celebrating the same advance the more; who live and reign with God the Father, in the unity of the Holy Spirit, God, world without end.

la: Grátiam nobis, Dómine, pcenitentiae, oratiónis, et humilitátis infúnde: ut beátæ Benvenutae Vírginis imitatióne possímus, et carnem mortificantes, spíritu vívere; et cæléstia júgiter cogitántes, nosque despiciéntes, in te solo Deo réquiem et glóriam inveníre: Per Dóminum nostrum Iesum Christum, Fílium tuum: qui tecum vivit et regnat in unitáte Spíritus Sancti Deus, per ómnia sǽcula sæculórum.

Accépta tibi sit, Dómine, sacrátæ plebis oblátio pro tuórum honóre Sanctórum, quorum se méritis de tribulatióne percepísse cognóscit auxílium: Per Dóminum nostrum Iesum Christum, Fílium tuum: qui tecum vivit et regnat in unitáte Spíritus Sancti Deus, per ómnia sǽcula sæculórum.
en: May this offering of Your people be accepted by You, O Lord, for the honor of those Your saints through whose merits they are sensible of having received help in their tribulations; through our Lord Jesus Christ, Your Son, who lives and reigns with You in the unity of the Holy Spirit, God, world without end.

la: Satiásti Dómine famíliam tuam munéribus sacris: ejus, quǽsumus, semper interventióne nos réfove; cujus solémnia celebrámus: Per Dóminum nostrum Iesum Christum, Fílium tuum: qui tecum vivit et regnat in unitáte Spíritus Sancti Deus, per ómnia sǽcula sæculórum.
en: You have satisfied Your family, O Lord, with Your gifts; ever re-inflame our zeal by the intercession of him whose feast we celebrate; through our Lord Jesus Christ, Your Son, who lives and reigns with You in the unity of the Holy Spirit, God, world without end.

la: Deus, qui beátum Simónem Confessórem tuum inter céteras ejus virtútes jugi orándi stúdio, et singulári humilitátis prærogatíva decorásti; ipsum nobis imitári concéde: ut spretis ómnibus, quæ sunt mundi, te hic solum quǽrere; ac tandem promíssa in cælis humílibus prǽmia cónsequi váleam us: Per Dóminum nostrum Iesum Christum, Fílium tuum: qui tecum vivit et regnat in unitáte Spíritus Sancti Deus, per ómnia sǽcula sæculórum.

Præsta nobis, quǽsumus omnípotens Deus, ut nostræ humilitátis oblátio, et pro tuórum tibi grata sit honóre Sanctórum, et nos córpore páriter et mente puríficet: Per Dóminum nostrum Iesum Christum, Fílium tuum: qui tecum vivit et regnat in unitáte Spíritus Sancti Deus, per ómnia sǽcula sæculórum.
en: Grant, we pray You, almighty God, that the offering of our lowliness may, for the honor of Ypur saints, be pleasing to You, and cleanse us in body and soul: through our Lord.. Through our Lord Jesus Christ, Your Son, who lives and reigns with You in the unity of the Holy Spirit, God, world without end.

la: Quǽsumus omnípotens Deus: ut qui cæléstia aliménta percépimus; intercedénte beáto Simóne Confessóre tuo, per hæc contra ómnia advérsa muniámur: Per Dóminum nostrum Iesum Christum, Fílium tuum: qui tecum vivit et regnat in unitáte Spíritus Sancti Deus, per ómnia sǽcula sæculórum.
en: We beseech You, almighty God, that we who have received this heavenly food m;:i,through the pleading of blessed Vincent, Your. confessor, be shielded from all adversity; through our Lord Jesus Christ, Your Son, who lives and reigns with You in the unity of the Holy Spirit, God, world without end.

la: Deus, qui beáto Petro fámulo tuo misericórditer tribuísti pro veræ fídei defensióne martýrio coronári: ejus méritis et intercessióne concéde; ut fide, quæ per caritátem operátur, tibi júgiter placére valeámus: Per Dóminum nostrum Iesum Christum, Fílium tuum: qui tecum vivit et regnat in unitáte Spíritus Sancti Deus, per ómnia sǽcula sæculórum.
en: O God, who mercifully granted to Your servant, blessed Peter, to be crowned with martyrdom in his defense of the true faith; grant that at his prayers we may be enabled ever to please You by the faith that works through charity; through our Lord Jesus Christ, Your Son, who lives and reigns with You in the unity of the Holy Spirit, God, world without end.

la: Sacrifícium tibi, Dómine, laudis et gratiárum actiónis offeréntes pro victória beáti Petri Mártyris tui, supplíciter deprecámur imménsam bonitátem tuam, ut fidélem pópulum in sancta religióne consérves, et hærética fraude dispérsos ad veritátis tuæ révoces unitátem: Per Dóminum nostrum Iesum Christum, Fílium tuum: qui tecum vivit et regnat in unitáte Spíritus Sancti Deus, per ómnia sǽcula sæculórum.

Deus, qui ea ipsa die, qua Unigénitus tuus cum nostræ carnis substántia ab immaculáta Vírgine Matre in templo est præsentátus; ánimam beáti Petri Mártyris in cælum suscepísti: ejus nobis intercessióne concéde, ut in vitæ éxitu divínis mystériis expiáti; in templo glóriæ tuæ præsentári mereámur: Per eúmdem Dóminum nostrum Iesum Christum Fílium tuum, qui tecum vivit et regnat in unitáte Spíritus Sancti, Deus, per ómnia sǽcula sæculórum.

Deus, qui beátum Joánnem Confessórem tuum plena sui abnegatióne, atque exímiæ caritátis zelo claréscere voluísti: ejus nobis imitatióne concéde; ut abdicátis terrénis afféctibus, in tua dilectióne vivámus: Per Dóminum nostrum Iesum Christum, Fílium tuum: qui tecum vivit et regnat in unitáte Spíritus Sancti Deus, per ómnia sǽcula sæculórum.
en: O God who made blessed John, Your confessor, illustrious by the deepest self-denial and. the utmost zeal for charity; grant us at his example to cast away all affection for things of earth, and to live evermore in Your love: through our Lord. MEMORY OF ST. BRICE, B.C. Through our Lord Jesus Christ, Your Son, who lives and reigns with You in the unity of the Holy Spirit, God, world without end.

la: Præsta nobis, quǽsumus omnípotens Deus, ut nostræ humilitátis oblátio, et pro tuórum tibi grata sit honóre Sanctórum, et nos córpore páriter et mente puríficet: Per Dóminum nostrum Iesum Christum, Fílium tuum: qui tecum vivit et regnat in unitáte Spíritus Sancti Deus, per ómnia sǽcula sæculórum.
en: Grant, we pray You, almighty God, that the offering of our lowliness may, for the honor of Ypur saints, be pleasing to You, and cleanse us in body and soul: through our Lord.. Through our Lord Jesus Christ, Your Son, who lives and reigns with You in the unity of the Holy Spirit, God, world without end.

la: Quǽsumus omnípotens Deus: ut qui cæléstia aliménta percépimus; intercedénte beáto Joánne Confessóre tuo, per hæc contra ómnia advérsa muniámur: Per Dóminum nostrum Iesum Christum, Fílium tuum: qui tecum vivit et regnat in unitáte Spíritus Sancti Deus, per ómnia sǽcula sæculórum.
en: We beseech You, almighty God, that we who have received this heavenly food m;:i,through the pleading of blessed Vincent, Your. confessor, be shielded from all adversity; through our Lord Jesus Christ, Your Son, who lives and reigns with You in the unity of the Holy Spirit, God, world without end.

la: Deus, qui beátam Lúciam, passiónis Fílii tui signaculis mirabíliter decoratam; virginitátis et patiéntiæ donis, blandiéntem mundum eludere, et persequéntem superáre fecísti: da ut ejus intercessióne et exémplo, nec terrénis vincamur illécebris; nec ullis frangamur advérsis: Per eúmdem Dóminum nostrum Iesum Christum Fílium tuum, qui tecum vivit et regnat in unitáte Spíritus Sancti, Deus, per ómnia sǽcula sæculórum.

Accépta tibi sit, Dómine, sacrátæ plebis oblátio pro tuórum honóre Sanctórum, quorum se méritis de tribulatióne percepísse cognóscit auxílium: Per Dóminum nostrum Iesum Christum, Fílium tuum: qui tecum vivit et regnat in unitáte Spíritus Sancti Deus, per ómnia sǽcula sæculórum.
en: May this offering of Your people be accepted by You, O Lord, for the honor of those Your saints through whose merits they are sensible of having received help in their tribulations; through our Lord Jesus Christ, Your Son, who lives and reigns with You in the unity of the Holy Spirit, God, world without end.

la: Satiásti Dómine famíliam tuam munéribus sacris: ejus, quǽsumus, semper interventióne nos réfove; cujus solémnia celebrámus: Per Dóminum nostrum Iesum Christum, Fílium tuum: qui tecum vivit et regnat in unitáte Spíritus Sancti Deus, per ómnia sǽcula sæculórum.
en: You have satisfied Your family, O Lord, with Your gifts; ever re-inflame our zeal by the intercession of him whose feast we celebrate; through our Lord Jesus Christ, Your Son, who lives and reigns with You in the unity of the Holy Spirit, God, world without end.

la: Deus, qui beátam Maríam semper Vírginem, Spíritus Sancti habitáculum hodiérna die in templo præsentári voluísti; præsta quǽsumus, ut ejus intercessióne in templo glóriæ tuæ presentari mereámur: Per Dóminum... in unitáte ejúsdem.
en: O God, You were pleased that the blessed Mary ever-virgin, herself the dwelling place <?tie Holy Spirit, should on this day be presented in the "temple; grant, we beseech You, that through her prayers, we may be worthy to be presented in the temple of Your glory: through our Lord. after prudent in Christo: not infirm, cos after fortes; cos nobles, not after ignoble. la: Unigéniti tui, Dómine, nobis succúrrat hum anitas: ut qui natus de Vírgine, Matris integritátem non mínuit, sed sacrávit, in solemnitáte ejus, nostris nos piáculis éxuens, oblatiónem nostram tibi fáciat accéptam: Jesus Christus Dóminus noster, qui tecum. Præfatio de B. María Vírgine Et te in Præsentatione.

Súmpsimus, Dómine, celebritátis ánnuæ votíva sacraménta; præsta quǽsumus, ut et temporális vitæ nobis remédia prǽbeant, et ætérnæ: Per Dóminum nostrum Iesum Christum, Fílium tuum: qui tecum vivit et regnat in unitáte Spíritus Sancti Deus, per ómnia sǽcula sæculórum.
en: We have received, 0, Lord, the votive sacraments of our yearly feast; grant, we beseech You, that these may be to us a remedy both in this life and toward life eternal; through our Lord Jesus Christ, Your Son, who lives and reigns with You in the unity of the Holy Spirit, God, world without end.

la: Deus, qui beáto Jacóbo Confessóri tuo atque Pontífici ómnia boni pastóris múnia fidéliter explére tribuísti: ejus intercessióne nobis concéde; ut per viam mandatórum tuórum gradiéntes, inter oves páscuæ tuæ perpétuo collocári mereámur: Per Dóminum nostrum Iesum Christum, Fílium tuum: qui tecum vivit et regnat in unitáte Spíritus Sancti Deus, per ómnia sǽcula sæculórum.

Offérimus tibi, Dómine, hóstiam immaculátam, supplíciter deprecántes, ut intercedénte beáto Jacóbo, ab omni labe expurgati, nos ipsos hóstiam placéntem tibi exhibeámus: Per Dóminum nostrum Iesum Christum, Fílium tuum: qui tecum vivit et regnat in unitáte Spíritus Sancti Deus, per ómnia sǽcula sæculórum.

Intervéniat pro nobis, quǽsumus Dómine, beátus Jacóbus Conféssor et Póntifex: ej usque précibus concéde; ut cælésti pábulo enutríti, cuncta terréna respuamus: Per Dóminum nostrum Iesum Christum, Fílium tuum: qui tecum vivit et regnat in unitáte Spíritus Sancti Deus, per ómnia sǽcula sæculórum.

Deus, qui beátum Sebastiánum Confessórem tuum reguláris disciplínæ, et evangélicæ perfectiónis singulári stúdio mirábilem effecísti: concéde propítius, ut ejus imitatióne carne mortificáti, et vivificati spíritu; ætérna prǽmia consequámur: Per Dóminum nostrum Iesum Christum, Fílium tuum: qui tecum vivit et regnat in unitáte Spíritus Sancti Deus, per ómnia sǽcula sæculórum.

Plasta nobis, quǽsumus omnípotens Deus, ut nostræ humilitátis oblátio, et pro tuórum tibi grata sit honóre Sanctórum, et nos córpore páriter et mente puríficet: Per Dóminum nostrum Iesum Christum, Fílium tuum: qui tecum vivit et regnat in unitáte Spíritus Sancti Deus, per ómnia sǽcula sæculórum.
en: Grant, we pray You, almighty God, that the offering of our lowliness may, for the honor of Ypur saints, be pleasing to You, and cleanse us in body and soul: through our Lord.. Through our Lord Jesus Christ, Your Son, who lives and reigns with You in the unity of the Holy Spirit, God, world without end.

la: Quǽsumus omnípotens Deus: ut qui cæléstia aliménta percépimus; intercedénte beáto Sebastiáno Confessóre tuo, per hæc contra ómnia advérsa muniámur: Per Dóminum nostrum Iesum Christum, Fílium tuum: qui tecum vivit et regnat in unitáte Spíritus Sancti Deus, per ómnia sǽcula sæculórum.
en: We beseech You, almighty God, that we who have received this heavenly food m;:i,through the pleading of blessed Vincent, Your. confessor, be shielded from all adversity; through our Lord Jesus Christ, Your Son, who lives and reigns with You in the unity of the Holy Spirit, God, world without end.

la: Amátor animárum Deus, qui in beáta María Bartholomsea Vírgine tua, miram ægritúdinum tolerántiam pari cum innocéntia sociásti: concéde, ut qui ex mérito nostrse actiónis afflígimur; tuse grátisë consolatióne respirémus: Per Dóminum nostrum Iesum Christum, Fílium tuum: qui tecum vivit et regnat in unitáte Spíritus Sancti Deus, per ómnia sǽcula sæculórum.
en: O God, lover of souls, who in blessed Mary Bartholomew, Your virgin, linked a wondrous steadfastness in suffering with equal innocence; grant that we who suffer as a result of our sins, may be refreshed by the consolations of Your grace; through our Lord Jesus Christ, Your Son, who lives and reigns with You in the unity of the Holy Spirit, God, world without end.

la: Panem Angelórum, et vinum gérminans vírgines, offeréntes tibi Dómine, beáta María Bartholomsea Vírgine intercedénte, a sórdibus líbera: ut inter puras Angelórum ácies perpétuo collocári mereámur: Per Dóminum nostrum Iesum Christum, Fílium tuum: qui tecum vivit et regnat in unitáte Spíritus Sancti Deus, per ómnia sǽcula sæculórum.

Effúnde super nos, Dómine Jesu, grátiam tuse miseratiónis: et prsesta, ut intercedénte beáta María Bartholomsea Vírgine tua, ab ómnibus adversitátibus liberémur; et in tuo servítio perseverántes, ad ætérnam perveníre lætítiam valeámus. Qui vivis et regnas cum Deo Patre, in unitáte Spíritus Sancti, Deus, per ómnia sǽcula sæculórum.

Deus, qui gloriósam Matrem tuam nominári Maríam voluísti: concéde quǽsumus, ut qui dulce Maríæ nomen implórant; perpétuum séntiant suæ benedictiónis auxílium. Qui vivis et regnas cum Deo Patre, in unitáte Spíritus Sancti, Deus, per ómnia sǽcula sæculórum.
en: O God, who willed that Your glorious mother should be called Mary; grant, we beseech You, that whoever calls upon the sweet name of Mary may feel the unfailing help of her blessing: who live. Who live and reign with God the Father, in the unity of the Holy Spirit, God, world without end.

la: Tua, Dómine, propitiatióne, et beátæ Maríæ semper Vírginis intercessióne, ad perpétuam atque præséntem hæc oblátio nobis profíciat prosperitátem et pacem: Per Dóminum nostrum Iesum Christum, Fílium tuum: qui tecum vivit et regnat in unitáte Spíritus Sancti Deus, per ómnia sǽcula sæculórum.
en: By Your mercy, O Lord, and the pleading of the blessed Mary, ever-virgin, may this offering bring us our prosperity and peace now and forever: through our Lord. Preface: No. 11, p. 655. Through our Lord Jesus Christ, Your Son, who lives and reigns with You in the unity of the Holy Spirit, God, world without end.

la: Sumptis, Dómine, salútis nostræ subsídiis: da, quǽsumus, beátæ Maríæ semper Vírginis patrocíniis nos ubíque prótegi; in cujus veneratióne hæc tuæ obtúlimus majestáti: Per Dóminum nostrum Iesum Christum, Fílium tuum: qui tecum vivit et regnat in unitáte Spíritus Sancti Deus, per ómnia sǽcula sæculórum.
